name: How does a tub-to-shower conversion improve bathroom accessibility?

mainEntity.name: How does a tub-to-shower conversion improve bathroom accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: A walk-in shower conversion provides significant safety advantages, especially for seniors or family members with mobility challenges. Stepping over a high bathtub wall is a primary slip-and-fall hazard. A conversion allows for low-curb or roll-in zero-threshold entries, slip-resistant floor tiles, sturdy wall-anchored grab bars, built-in seating, and handheld shower wands. During the framing stage, solid wood blocking is installed inside the wall studs, ensuring that grab bars and folding benches are securely anchored to support full body weight.
acceptedAnswer.description: It eliminates high tub walls, reducing fall risks. It also allows low-threshold or roll-in entries, textured slip-resistant tile, built-in benches, and reinforced grab bars.
